exposure: Implementation of a SSI care bundle for cesareans
outcome: Cesarean delivery surgical site infection (SSI) rates
cohort: Women with a gestational age of at least 23 0/7 weeks who delivered a liveborn neonate(s) between 2012 and 2015 at the study hospital
finding: A significant reduction in SSI rate in cesarean deliveries was seen following implementation of an infection prevention bundle.
